notes: Fleeting Flight, printed: 'Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. It gains flying until end of turn. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.' Seat 0 attacks with a 2/2; seat 1 blocks with a 5/5. After blockers, seat 0 casts it on the attacker: a +1/+1 counter makes it 3/3. In the damage step the 5/5's 5 combat damage to it is prevented (no damage marked on it, it survives), while it deals its 3 to the blocker.
